shared_elements: dense relief carving covering the surface
possible anthropomorphic/mask-like forms among the ornament
justification: Both surfaces are covered with dense curvilinear scroll and spiral motifs cut in relief, and both may include mask-like or anthropomorphic elements embedded in that scrollwork, which is the most specific correspondence. But B is organised around a single large frontal standing human figure in an elaborate plumed headdress and pectoral regalia within a vertical framed panel, while A shows loosely scattered, largely abstract curvilinear designs distributed over irregular rock faces with no dominant figure or compositional axis.
